title: Equipment and jewelry source transcription audit
method: Every PNG was opened and read at full size; the printed rows were typed into data/gear-source/transcription (one text file per set). Automated OCR was not used as an authority. No record is marked verified: a human check against each image is still pending.

reviewItems.note: The 8 effect prints "Punch Rate −40%" with a minus sign next to a Weaken enemy's ATK +5% bonus; kept exactly as printed, sign and intent to be confirmed.
Two 2-piece effects print a 110% chance (Agility: Silence, Power: Chaos); kept exactly as printed.
The 8 effect prints "Weekend enemies' ATK +25%" (probable misspelling of "Weaken"); kept exactly as printed.
Variant B differs from variant A only in the second-blow rate type: "Physical ATK rate" instead of "Strategy ATK rate" (Chakra and Agility cells). No label printed; not named R1 or R2.
The Power cell prints "Reduce enemy ATK −20%" with a minus sign; kept exactly as printed.
The 4-piece text prints "(dot—120%)" with a long dash; kept exactly as printed.
Chakra prints "HP +90%", Agility "Avoid-Injury Rate +65%", Power "Phy/Str. DEF +99%" and Force "Decrease enemy CC Rate +46%"; values are unusually high and are kept exactly as printed.
The 2-piece text prints "Attack +13" without a percent sign (the 4 and 6 piece texts print +15%); kept exactly as printed, unit to be confirmed.

NAME DISCREPANCY: the uploader names this set Mekansm; the title printed on both source sheets reads MEKA. The set is stored under the uploader name "Mekansm" with the source title "MEKA" recorded as a source alias. Canonical name to be confirmed by the client.

The R1 label comes from the owner's upload mapping and the client's statement; the screenshot itself prints no "R1" text. It is applied because the client explicitly named this version. The sheet differs from the base sheet in stat values (67000 against 65500, Power 670000 against 65500), two chances (80% to 90%), and the numbers +43%, +53% and +32%.

In the base sheet the Power category prints its base value as "65500" while the other versions of the pattern print 10 times the value for Power (670000 in R1). Kept exactly as printed; to be confirmed.

Equipment stages printed on the cost sheet are R1, R2, R3, SSR4 and SSR5. The equipment bonus sheet prints only two bonus blocks: "Warlord Base" and "SSR5 Warlord". Bonus blocks for R1, R2, R3 and SSR4 are not in the source and are not invented. SSR5 is not relabelled R2.
The accessories carry two separate version series, R1 and R2 (printed on the icons and on the cost sheets). No base accessory sheet is in the source and none is assumed.

The single printed main-stat block (71000 / Power 710000) is shown once above the Base and SSR5 bonus blocks; it is stored on the Base version only. Whether SSR5 changes the main stats is not shown in the source.
Two gear sheets and two jewelry sheets, none with a printed version label. Stored as sequence variants A and B; no R1/R2 name is justified by the larger numbers. Client decision needed.
